author: GameTrailers
description: FIGHT! COOK! SERVE! Play as Pranzo, a tiny chef-warrior who cooks monsters right on the battlefield. In this action RPG, explore the world of Delizia, grow your inn’s reputation, serve picky customers, and rise through the ranks of the ancient Monster Chef Order as you uncover its secrets. Check out the colorful world and gameplay from Monster Chef in this trailer for the upcoming action RPG. Monster Chef will be available on PC.
title: Monster Chef - Official Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: It's time to hit the road in Rome. Mini Motorways is a strategy simulation game about designing the road map for a growing city. Build a traffic network, one road at a time, to create a bustling metropolis. Redesign your roads and place your motorways to get everyone where they need to go. How long can you keep the city moving? The new trailer for Mini Motorways showcases what's coming with the new update, where you'll build roads in Rome. Mini Motorways is out now on Apple Arcade, Steam, and Nintendo Switch. The new update is coming in Winter 2026.
title: Mini Motorways - Official Update Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from LOP: Whitefall, an upcoming 2D action game redefined through Extreme Destruction. Every impact is physical. Enemies aren’t health bars, destroy them outright, or dismantle them until they can’t fight back. You’ll explore a world fallen silent, navigating its weathered ruins sealed in ice to uncover the secrets it buried. LOP: Whitefall will be available on PC.
title: LOP: Whitefall - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Team up with new heroes Alice and Dusty as they embark on an epic adventure across the mysterious Arkadera Peninsula. Develop unique combat skills, gather precious materials, forge powerful items, and tend to your growing farm, either alone or with a friend! Watch the new Kitaria Fables 2 trailer for this upcoming action RPG. Kitaria Fables 2 will be available on Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam in spring 2027.
title: Kitaria Fables 2 - Official Release Window Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at Kick and see how the game has been updated in this new comparison trailer for the upcoming sports 2D side-scrolling platformer game. Kick is a nostalgic tale of making your way to school, all the while honing your soccer skills throughout challenging levels packed with unique challenges. Do you have what it takes to Kick it? Kick will be available on PC on November 3, 2026.
title: Kick - Official Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Keep It Up! is a 4 player co-op physics game where you and your fellow genetically test subjects slap a balloon through a mysterious obstacle course without it touching the ground. You've gotta Keep It Up! Kept It Up! will be available on PC.
title: Keep It Up! - Official Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from Iron Bramble in this new trailer for the upcoming momentum-based platforming game built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins. Iron Bramble will be available on Steam in 2027.
title: Iron Bramble - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from Into The Fire in this new trailer for the upcoming high-risk extraction survival game. Race an exploding volcano in Into The Fire. Rescue survivors, manage scarce resources, survive fire anomalies, and carve escape routes through ash and lava. Bring them back alive, before the island buries you. Into The Fire will be available on PC in 2026.
title: Into The Fire - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail. Inkblood will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Inkblood - Official Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: A father. A condemned theatre. A son’s voice echoing from the beyond. Step into a narrative horror game about grief, obsession, and the act of holding on as a force older than grief pushes back. Watch the new Impermanence trailer for another look at this upcoming narrative horror game. Impermanence will be available on Steam in 2027.
title: Impermanence - Official Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Race, trick, and explore across vibrant slopes with a cast of unique riders. Master speed, style, and control in this fast-paced arcade snowboarder. Prove it where it counts, split-screen with friends or head-to-head online multiplayer. Shred the mountain. Rip the competition. Get a fresh look at HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate in this latest trailer. HYPERyuki will be available on PC. A demo is coming soon to Steam.
title: HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate - Official Demo | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Attention! Husk Protocol Initiated! Prepare to engage in a challenging deck-driven mecha game. Synergize between powerful Husks, utilize a dynamic deck and avoid detection from the city’s mainframe as you infiltrate the machine-driven brutopolis of Aeterna. Check out gameplay from Husk Protocol in this latest trailer. Husk Protocol will be available on PC. A playtest is out now.
title: Husk Protocol - Official Playtest Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game that invites you to uncover the mystery without a single word spoken, using your skills of logic and intuition through cards. Hillthorn will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, the App Store, and Google Play on November 10, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Hillthorn - Official Release Date Trailer | The MIX Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for HeroQuest: Digital Edition, an upcoming video game adaptation of dungeon-crawling board game. HeroQuest: Digital Edition will be available on PC.
title: HeroQuest: Digital Edition - Official Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Grobnopolis: Last Days is a slow, oppressive atmospheric horror experience where curiosity is both compass and curse. The sun is gone. The mines are bleeding. Walk the dying city of Huta-Grobno, tune into forbidden broadcasts and survive the last days of a world rotting under the clouds. Grobnopolis: Last Days will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Grobnopolis: Last Days - Official Demo Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026
